data.name: Hudhud
data.gender_notes: Hudhud is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Hudhud refers to the hoopoe bird, known for its distinctive call and migratory patterns. In Islamic tradition, the hoopoe is said to have been the companion of the Prophet Sulaiman (AS) and played a significant role in his kingdom. The name Hudhud carries the meaning “Type of bird” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hudhud usually hope their child will grow to embody type of bird and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The hoopoe's ability to migrate and adapt symbolizes resilience and determination in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Hudhud belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Type of bird.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hudhud total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
